changelog:
• Crash-Proof Native Inference: Switched YOLOv8 to multi-threaded CPU XNNPACK to eliminate MediaTek Dimensity 7050 OpenCL driver crashes
• Zero-Switch Home Wi-Fi Streaming: Direct streaming over home Wi-Fi (192.168.1.102:81) without switching to SoftAP
• UI Rebrand & Polish: Renamed dialog to 'CONNECT NEURONOVA', removed yellow lightning/signal warning icons, reduced timeout to 1500ms
• Multi-Client Stream Engine: High-performance non-blocking socket stream server on port 81 supporting multiple devices concurrently
